image_prompt: A whimsical, vibrant illustration of a giant, smiling horseshoe magnet hovering playfully over a city. Below it, all sorts of metal objects – cars, lampposts, tiny robots, even metal fillings from people's teeth – are gently floating upwards towards the magnet, creating a humorous, chaotic scene. The Portuguese text "O ímã atrai metal." is prominently displayed on a banner carried by a tiny flying robot. The style is cartoonish and full of movement, with bright, contrasting colors.
caption: Em um mundo cheio de mistérios, algumas verdades são como um ímã: inegáveis! ✨ Quem nunca ficou fascinado com a força da natureza? Qual a sua 'atração' óbvia do dia? Conta pra gente! #ObvioEIncontestavel #PoderDoIma #CienciaDivertida #AtraçõesDaVida #VerdadesUniversais
